name: Daisy Goes to Slime Castle for Tea
summary:
Everyone's favorite RPG Maker 2000/2003 default priestess actor goes on yet another perilous quest! A princess held hostage in a castle of slimes! A boyfriend who is feeling quite unwell! As the weekend draws nearer, how will Daisy manage to address both of these? And what's tea got to do with all of it?

Made as a part of the 2023 Vextro Slime Wave Jam, Daisy Goes To Slime Castle for Tea is a micro-RPG awkwardly written to be a love letter to VIPRPGs, the loose "Moshimo" canon, and the wider RPG Tsukuru/Tkool/Maker series as a whole.
